layers.quote: Our auditors have expressed substantial doubt about our ability to continue as a going concern.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: It went from 5,300 employees to about 3,700.

the latest filing page lands

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Then the same shoe came back. Last year, the company's sales were about $4.04B.

params.place: a Crocs outlet sign, then a row of clogs covered in charms

a cut to a Crocs store sign, rising

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: So what brought Crocs back? Not a new shoe. What the company did with the old one.

params.place: a pair of clogs on beach sand

moments.what: the chapter card rises over the beach
the title lands

beats.say: Chapter one. So where did this shoe come from?

moments.what: the camera pushes to the product overview
the highlighter swipes the line

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Crocs first went on sale in 2002, as a single model in 6 colours.

params.place: the shoreline, then clogs in the sand

moments.what: waves roll in
a cut to clogs in the sand

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: It was sold first to water sports fans: a light foam shoe called the Beach.
